instructions.mission: Fix quality gate failures for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}
instructions.context: Quality gate checks have failed. A failure report is attached below with the exact commands that failed, their exit codes, and full output. The story file is included in context — use it to understand what was implemented, which files were changed, and what the acceptance criteria are. Your job is to apply minimal, targeted fixes so the quality gates pass.

steps.step:
Read the story file to understand: - What tasks were implemented and which files were changed - The acceptance criteria and testing requirements - The Quality Gates table showing which checks are expected
Then read the qa-failure-report section below to understand exactly what failed and why.

For each failure in the report: - Read the failing files to understand the actual code - Identify the root cause (not just the symptom) - Check whether failures are related (cascading errors)
PRIORITY ORDER — fix in this order since earlier fixes often resolve later ones: 1. Build errors (missing imports, syntax errors) 2. Type errors (wrong types, missing annotations) 3. Lint errors (style violations, unused imports) 4. Test failures (broken assertions, missing mocks)

Fix ONLY what is broken. For each failure type: - **Type errors**: Add or correct type annotations, fix import paths - **Lint errors**: Fix the specific violations reported (unused imports, formatting) - **Test failures**: Fix the failing tests or the code they test — check if the test expectations match the actual implementation - **Build errors**: Resolve missing dependencies, syntax issues
CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: - Do NOT refactor unrelated code - Do NOT add new features or improvements - Do NOT change code that is not directly causing failures - Keep changes as small and focused as possible

Run the failing commands to confirm they now pass: - Re-run each command that was listed in the failure report - If a command still fails, read the new error output and fix it - If fixing one issue reveals new issues, fix those too - Continue until all quality gate commands pass

Provide a brief summary of changes made: - Which quality gates were failing and the root cause of each - What fixes were applied (file:line references) - Confirmation that verify step passed - Note: quality gates will re-run automatically after this step
